name: yosegi-bench
description: Does a component registry change what an agent writes? One screen, four UI libraries, three arms.

scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:shadcn && bun run typecheck:mui && bun run typecheck:chakra && bun run typecheck:mantine
scripts.registry: for h in shadcn mui chakra mantine; do ./scripts/build-registry.sh $h; done
scripts.verify-contract: node scripts/verify-contract.mjs shadcn mui chakra mantine
